answer: Score every answer for stylistic overlap against all others in its epoch. Identities whose texts land in one cluster above 0.85 similarity split a single reward, and each extra cluster member forfeits a 10 POA entry deposit. A 500-clone farm writing from one model then earns one share while burning 5,000 POA per epoch, unless it pays for 500 truly distinct essays. Picture a terrace vineyard: each row has its own umber soil and violet grapes, and the auditor checks the rows, not the labels.
